findings: Existing GTK3 anchor means actual trailing native scrollbar edge; it does not mean stretching with window resize.
Horizontal origin subtracts measured native width and child offset; vertical subtracts measured height and offset.
Coordinates must remain within0..2048; invalid native placement is rejected.
GTK2 currently rejects this feature at backend guard, generator and scene levels; changing only the renderer cannot deliver it.
C controller records GTK2 anchors as pending capabilities; its own guard requires an independent update.
next_steps: Extract/reuse the existing geometry rule without changing its meaning
Connect GTK2 natural allocation and Ctrl gestures to trailing edge semantics
Update capability guards, generation and C/controller handling together
Prove horizontal/vertical behavior with native sizes and both origins before delivery
